title: verdict-register
description: Output of the validate skill. Scope-independent: one verdict record per unit, plus a gate result. What a UNIT is comes from the scope contract; this schema fixes the record shape and the show-your-work rules the hard gate enforces.

artifact.description: path or handle of the validated artifact

contract.description: path to the scope contract used

text.description: the unit's assertion or requirement, as extracted

tag.description: scope-defined classification, if the contract uses tags

authority.description: the source of truth checked (arXiv, statute, repo, test run, ...)

evidence.description: what the authority said: quote / value / resolved link / test output

flagged.description: true when this unit is a finding needing attention

allOf.$comment: show your work: a checked verdict must name its authority and evidence
findings must be flagged so nothing bad passes silently

findings.description: count of flagged units; gate.verdict is pass iff 0
